Trump household GEO trades were routine portfolio management unrelated to procurement

findings.target_name: The GEO Group FY2025 ICE activation wave
findings.summary: GEO disclosed a sequence of FY2025 ICE activations: Delaney Hall awarded February 27, North Lake announced for immediate activation March 20, and D. Ray James activated under a contract modification effective June 6.

findings.target_name: Donald J. Trump public financial disclosure / The GEO Group, Inc.
findings.summary: Donald J. Trump’s 2026 annual public financial disclosure for report year 2025 lists a GEO Group security in Investment Account #7 valued at $50,001-$100,000 and $1,001-$2,500 in dividends.

findings.target_name: Donald J. Trump periodic transaction disclosure / The GEO Group, Inc.
findings.summary: A periodic transaction report filed under Donald J. Trump reports a $15,001-$50,000 purchase of GEO Group securities on March 4, 2026 and marks that notification was received more than 30 days later.

findings.target_name: Donald J. Trump annual disclosure / GEO Group transaction series
findings.summary: Trump’s 2026 annual disclosure reports ten GEO Group purchases and four sales during 2025; summing only the disclosed value-category endpoints gives purchase bounds of $143,010-$445,000 and sale bounds of $67,004-$180,000.

findings.target_name: The GEO Group, Inc. SEC ownership disclosures / Trump household-reportable interest
findings.summary: GEO’s 2026 proxy identifies BlackRock and Vanguard as its only disclosed outside holders above 5% and does not identify Trump; that omission does not contradict the OGE-reported $50,001-$100,000 interest because GEO’s proxy table covers directors, officers and known holders above 5%.

findings.target_name: The GEO Group / Department of Homeland Security direct-prime procurement universe
findings.summary: After exact-key removal of parent/child overlaps, the normalized 14-UEI GEO universe contains 1,416 unique DHS prime-contract action rows across 222 award PIIDs and $6,356,699,228.62 in net action obligations from 2015-01-01 through 2026-07-13; ICE accounts for 1,362 actions/212 awards/$6,354,097,259.08 and CBP for 54 actions/10 awards/$2,601,969.54.

findings.target_name: GEO DHS prime-contract action timing by presidential administration
findings.summary: Within the corrected 2015–2026 action ledger, ICE net action obligations were $478,295,618.46 before Trump I, $1,686,365,164.41 during Trump I, $2,900,292,455.05 during Biden, and $1,289,144,021.16 during Trump II through 2026-07-13; CBP totals for those periods were $458,026.46, $852,954.45, $934,664.66, and $356,323.97.

findings.target_name: The GEO Group / DHS contract action pace by administration
findings.summary: Duration-normalized DHS GEO action frequency is only 7.3% higher in Trump II than Trump I through 2026-07-13, while net obligation pace is 106.8% higher because average obligation per action nearly doubled.

findings.target_name: Trump disclosure household / The GEO Group / DHS action timeline
findings.summary: All 15 OGE-reported GEO transaction dates from 2025-01-30 through 2026-03-04 fall within 14 days of at least one GEO DHS action, but dense action cadence, household anonymity, modifications, and procurement lead times make the proximity non-discriminating.

findings.target_name: Trump public financial disclosure household / The GEO Group
findings.summary: All 14 annual GEO transaction dates were part of broad Investment Account #7 activity; the March 4, 2026 PTR had 204 same-day transaction rows

findings.target_name: Trump public financial disclosure household / The GEO Group
findings.summary: DHS/GEO action-date proximity did not discriminate GEO trade dates from controls after separating base actions from modifications
